coaching.headline: We won four lanes, but converted zero of five won fights into a tower or camp.
coaching.team: The lane sheet read four of five matchups in our favor - carry, jungle and support all 'ours all game,' offlane flipping late - with only midlane reading even. None of it closed the game. We won five skirmishes across the match and converted zero of them into a tower or major camp within the window, while the other side turned four of their seven wins into one. Twice we held a one-man advantage - at the 20.6 Fangtooth fight and the 31.5 river fight - and still lost both, 0-2 and 2-3. Objective damage ran 36,645 to their 71,058, and three of our own inhibitors fell. The ending came in one chain: Greystone was caught alone at 37.3, the team fought the next contest a man down at 37.9, lost it 2-3, and the Core fell a minute later.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: We won five fights and converted none into a tower or camp, while the other side turned four of their seven - that gap, not the lane results, is why four favored lanes still lost 8 towers to 10.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane read even, but first blood (Steel on Revenant, 3.2) and the game's first Fangtooth both went our way, and the carry lane read favored the entire game.

focus.title: Zero conversion on five won fights
focus.evidence: We won five skirmishes and converted none into a tower or camp within the window; the other side converted four of their seven wins.
focus.action: Group and push immediately after a won fight instead of resetting - a tower or camp inside 90 seconds turns a won fight into map gains.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.8s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath, Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,570 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Serath jungle players this patch (30% of the team's). The damage came from Sky Splitter, Onixian Quiver, Tainted Rounds.

24 takedowns (14 kills, 10 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow), Fallen Grace (passive).
Serath dealt 61,239 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +222 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Renna (level 18: about 107 physical armor, 68 after penetration; took 26,004 physical damage from heroes, 53% of all hero damage they took) and Steel (level 18: about 345 physical armor, 247 after penetration; took 14,986 physical damage from heroes, 47% of all hero damage they took) that is about 23% and 28% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Ranged Basic Attack: Fire 2 additional projectiles. Each deals 10-35% (increases with Range) () Damage. Can Critically Strike and apply Lifesteal.
Onixian Quiver (item): On Melee Heroes only: Increase your Total Critical Strike Chance by 25%. Gain 1% Damage Mitigation for every 10% Missing Health.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Eviscerator (crest): Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.
Vital Resonance (augment): Fallen Grace's Visages restore (+170%) Health on pick-up.

Sustain: 21% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; Taproot: Basic Attacks restore 1 (+6% Bonus Physical Power) Health on-hit. Does not heal from Tower damage.; 20,794 healing recorded.
Toughness: +40 physical armor; took 67,233 damage, mitigated 45,014, died 5 times.

Lesson: Serath's penetration cut through: Renna took about 23% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 107, about 68 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 7 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Onixian Quiver, Tainted Rounds, Demolisher, Eviscerator, Weald, Taproot.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 6 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Onixian Quiver, Tainted Rounds, Draconum, Eviscerator, Taproot.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Vanquisher, Weald. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.

The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Taproot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage; finishing damage on low-health targets), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Serath killed built physical armor (Steel, Khaimera). Anti-heal on Renna, Steel. We killed Serath 5 times.
Copy it? Weald (Forage + Taproot): 46.2% in 208 Serath jungle games, below the hero's 49.8%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,629 hero damage a minute, more than 93% of Renna mid players this patch (37% of the team's). The damage came from Entropy, Megacosm, Tainted Scepter.
Abyssal Rift at rank 3: 95s base, about 60.1s by the end (37% shorter) from 58 ability haste: Entropy 15, Megacosm 10, Tainted Scepter 10, Lifebinder 15, Epoch 8.
18 takedowns (12 kills, 6 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Renna dealt 63,515 hero damage, 37% of their team's, with +515 magical power from items.

Penetration: Caustica ignores 35%; against Serath (level 18: about 62 magical armor, 40 after penetration; took 22,438 magical damage from heroes, 60% of all hero damage they took) and Argus (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 32 after penetration; took 23,669 magical damage from heroes, 79% of all hero damage they took) that is about 15% and 13% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Aion (Eternal): Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.
Sustain: 12% magical lifesteal; Tainted Scepter: On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.; 4,346 healing recorded.
Toughness: +450 health; took 54,396 damage, mitigated 40,613, died 10 times.
Lesson: Renna's penetration cut through: Serath took about 15% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 62, about 40 after 35% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Entropy, Megacosm, Caustica. Renna has 4 damaging abilities (Stupor hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 58 ability haste brought them back 37% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Scepter, Lifebinder.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Renna killed built magical armor (Zinx). Anti-heal on Zinx, Serath. We killed Renna 10 times.
Copy it? Aion: 52.4% in 655 Renna midlane games, level with the hero's 52.2%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
